record.paper_title: Mapping current and activity fluctuations in exclusion processes: consequences and open questions
record.context_brief: TBA corrections connecting EW and KPZ expansions
record.original_question: Can Thermodynamic Bethe Ansatz methods and their extensions compute corrections to the Edwards-Wilkinson activity-fluctuation scaling at large λ, where s = λ/L² in the diffusive regime, and can those corrections be matched to the next orders of the small-s expansion in the finite-s KPZ regime?

evidence.quote:
Thermodynamic Bethe Ansatz and its extensions allows one to obtain corrections to the EW scal-
ing (3.5) at large λ, as done in Ref. [58]: it could be instructive to see how the expansion matches the next
orders of the small- s expansion (3.22)-(3.23) in the KPZ regime.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the one-dimensional symmetric simple exclusion process (SSEP) on a periodic ring of L sites at half filling. Let A_t denote the total time-integrated activity (the number of particle jumps, in either direction, up to time t), and consider its scaled cumulant generating function (SCGF)

  ψ(λ) = lim_{t→∞} (1/t) log E[ exp(λ A_t) ].

Introduce the rescaled fugacity s = λ / L^2. There are two relevant regimes:

(a) Diffusive (Edwards–Wilkinson, EW) regime: λ fixed and L → ∞ (equivalently s → 0). In this regime, ψ(λ) admits a leading EW scaling form, and Thermodynamic Bethe Ansatz (TBA) techniques and their extensions are known to produce systematic large-λ corrections to this leading EW scaling.

(b) Finite-s (KPZ) regime: s held fixed as L → ∞. In this regime, ψ admits a small-s expansion of KPZ type, with computable subleading coefficients beyond the leading order.

Question: Develop TBA methods (and their generalizations) to compute the corrections to the EW activity-fluctuation scaling at large λ in the diffusive regime, and prove that, upon expressing both expansions in the common variable s = λ/L^2, the resulting large-λ TBA corrections in the diffusive regime match, term by term, the next-to-leading orders of the small-s expansion of ψ in the finite-s KPZ regime.
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open direction concerning matching TBA-derived corrections to the EW activity scaling against the small-s KPZ expansion in the symmetric exclusion process. No subsequent work explicitly establishing this matching was located; the problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Mapping current and activity fluctuations in exclusion processes
status_evidence.snippet: Discussion of open questions concerning activity fluctuations and TBA corrections to EW scaling.
status_evidence.claim: The matching of TBA large-λ corrections with the small-s KPZ expansion is posed as an open question.
